headline: ZIM-chartered container ship CONTSHIP JET sunk by 3 boat drones off Bulgaria, Black Sea

sources: Bulgarian Navy / Bulgarian authorities + ZIM confirmation, via Times of Israel, Ynetnews, Defense News
fault_line: War spillover or targeted hit? Was a ZIM-chartered ship in NATO waters collateral in the Black Sea drone war, or a deliberate message - and why can't a NATO member stop drones in its own EEZ?

sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT - sinking/rescue; ALLEGATION - attribution] The Liberian-flagged, Greek-owned container ship CONTSHIP JET, chartered by Israel's ZIM, sailing Haifa -> Constanta (Romania) with 421 containers, was struck by three unmanned surface vessels ~17 nautical miles east of Cape Kaliakra, inside Bulgaria's EEZ (outside territorial waters), on Wed Oct 28; it caught fire, listed and sank overnight. All 18 crew (14 Filipinos, 4 Ukrainians) were rescued by Bulgarian naval/border police vessels and taken to Varna, no injuries. Cargo incl. lithium-ion batteries, corrosive liquids/acids lost; Bulgarian Navy reports no signs of pollution in initial samples. Bulgarian Chief of Defense Adm. Emil Eftimov: Bulgaria could not destroy the sea drones - legal constraints (EEZ, not territorial waters) + adverse weather. A French maritime patrol aircraft monitored/supported rescue. Attacker identity UNCLEAR.
sections.what_verified: Sinking + rescue + cargo loss confirmed by Bulgarian Navy/authorities and ZIM across three declared-tier families: Times of Israel (T3), Ynetnews (T3), Defense News (T3). Bulgarian defense ministers' meeting context (Bulgaria/Romania/Turkey in Sofia) corroborated by Defense News.
sections.what_disputed: Attribution: initial assessments suggest the vessel was NOT targeted because of its Israel connection (Ynet); Bulgaria's government reluctant to assign blame; suspicion of Russia is unproven - PM Radev's earlier summoning of the Russian ambassador (Oct 13 incidents) explicitly noted no conclusive evidence. JFeed's headline attributing the strike to 'Russian drones' is NOT evidence and is not counted. i24's '9th civilian ship struck this month, 30+ sailors dead' is undeclared-tier context, noted not counted.
sections.why_matters: A ship from Haifa sunk in NATO waters: 421 containers gone, 18 crew saved, nobody claims it - the Black Sea shipping war just touched Israel-linked cargo
